description: This file defines the ShapeMap class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods for managing shape definitions used in the AWS API, including constructing shape objects and resolving shape references based on shape names.

classes.name: ShapeMap
classes.description: A class for building and resolving AWS API shape definitions based on shape references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ShapeMap with an array of shape models.

methods.name: getShapeNames
methods.description: Returns an array of shape names defined in the shape map.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a shape reference into a Shape object, potentially caching simple shapes for efficiency.
